C6 overrides only upper M/H/D, so its current lower trial remains 0.023. Core wetness uses the current trial reservoir and capacity 0.22*(1.0000000000000002+0.35000000000000003)=0.2970000000000001. The retained formula min((M/C)^(2/3),1) gives 0.18168298549974593, bits 0x3fc74163587b03b8, exactly the observed left value. The asserted 0x3fc3bfd8fa998876 equals the same formula at beginning mass 0.018. This is a test-oracle provenance error, not evidence of changed physics or an incorrect wet-fraction implementation.
